newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs seen steady to lower, pork bellies mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs seen steady to lower, pork bellies mixed.

text.p: CME lean hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.100 cent per lb lower and calls on pork belly futures ranged from 0.100 cent per lb lower to 0.100 higher, livestock analysts said.
Steady to lower cash hog indications and further losses in cash pork products were expected to weigh on hog futures. Falling pork prices have been keeping packer bids down, they said.
However, losses in futures may be limited by some forecasts for a return to warmer weather which could curb hog runs and in turn buoy cash hog prices, some sources said.
Mixed trade is also possible as the "Goldman roll" continues, which traders explained as the rolling of positions by Goldman Sachs for their commodity index, they said.

Pork belly indications were mixed after mixed action Tuesday. Although cash belly prices have eased this week, those prices may be near a bottom after a recent sharp break. A neutral CME out-of-town report on Tuesday and light deliveries should also reduce pressure on futures, they added.
